description: StarPort BBS Intro II by Future Crew, a 1,993-byte advert for their home BBS, running in your browser.
about: A 1,993-byte intro Future Crew made for StarPort, their home BBS, in November 1993, released with its source.
credits: Code by Psi, music by Skaven.
released: Released on 21 November 1993, and its source on 2 December 1993.
terms: Public domain: “This code is released to the public domain.” (SP2.ASM)
accuracy: Its AdLib music plays through the FM chip of the emulated Sound Blaster 16.
Not yet compared with a capture made on real hardware.
imageAlt: StarPort BBS Intro II's text flying through its starfield, running in DosKit
